note: Father of George William. Died when his son was 23.
DIED THE YEAR AFTER HER SON WAS BORN. Martha Maude Castle is named for her.

Baptised 4 Jan 1863, St Mary's Baldock — "Parents George & Martha, abode Willian". 1871 and 1881 censuses: at Norton End with his grandparents. Agricultural labourer 1891 (Middle Row, Baldock); farm labourer 1901 (Norton End).
Came to Baldock from Weston just before her first marriage — the tree's own note, implying a later second marriage.
Earlier than this archive had it (1883).
BORN BEFORE THE MARRIAGE, and carries her mother's maiden name.
Baptised 17 Jun 1892. Married Walter George Brown. Paul Harrison's grandmother.
EXACT DATE OF BIRTH, new. Baptised 22 Sep 1895, Baldock. Married Henry Robert Wear, October 1914, Hitchin. Death and burial supplied by THIS archive, not his.
